task: Phase 3: device access evaluation and delegation. AccessActor + DeviceAccessResolver + DeviceAccessPolicy replace AuthorizationContext/DeviceAuthorizationPolicy; AccessActorFactory builds the actor over a latest-wins PermissionGrantResolver; master-admin is unconditional; SendDeviceCommandHandler checks the permission code resolved from the catalog (PERMISSION_UNMAPPED, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, catalog TTL); grant handlers take the actor and enforce the grant rules, with the PermissionGrantsController 400/403 mapping; five delegation handlers for device roles and memberships; IAuthorizationEpochStore.AdvanceMany; IUserScopeStore.IsMasterAdmin. No DB schema change, no frontend change.
acceptanceCriteria: a wildcard allow grants nothing: ScopeAuthorization.cs, FeaturePermissionAuthorizationHandler.cs, Domain authorization and DeviceCommandsController.cs no longer mention the wildcard; Application authorization only checks the wildcard deny (PermissionGrantResolver) and rejects wildcard grants (grant handler)

master-admin is unconditional: a persisted users.manage deny (and a wildcard deny) blocks neither the users.manage policy nor ScopeAuthorization.HasFeaturePermission (POST /users/roles 204); a resource deny removes no organization (GET /devices still lists the denied organization's device); the master-before-deny rule lives only in ResolvedFeaturePermissions.Has and AccessActorFactory.EffectiveOrganizations

AccessActorFactory: missing or malformed id -> null; master-admin gets every organization even with claim or persisted resource denies; non-master: expand child organizations, then subtract denies; latest-wins grant->deny->grant; wildcard allow dropped; ScopeAuthorization only delegates

LatestFeatureGrants/LatestResourceGrants keep the last row of grant->deny->grant, choose by PolicyVersion not input order; Features/Organizations are built on them and nothing else picks the latest grant row

a member with only a membership is in scope with exactly the role's permissions on that device and gets DEVICE_NOT_FOUND on another device of the same organization; a scope admin without membership has only device.view
role adc.view: get_status on the 5 other namespaces and mqtt.get_config -> DEVICE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED; adc.get_status -> COMMAND_RECORDED
3 confirm rows -> CONFIRM_REQUIRED when confirm is blank; 24 rows with TTL 60000 plan 60s; the row with null TTL plans 120s

delegation matrix covers every design-contract §4 code, including DEVICE_ROLE_INVALID, DEVICE_ROLE_NAME_TAKEN reported by the store case-insensitively (no handler pre-check), stale before in-use on delete, store compare-and-set -> DEVICE_MEMBERSHIP_CHANGED; roles accept device.view and sys.config_import

write ordering: when the store writes, PolicyVersion and epochs are not yet advanced; when an epoch advances, PolicyVersion already has; epochs advance only where a holder may lose access (replace/remove membership: that device; fresh assign: none; role update: one AdvanceMany call); a failing post-commit signal still returns OK

assign with a stale expectedRoleVersion -> DEVICE_ROLE_VERSION_STALE even for master-admin; a non-master cannot shrink a role beyond its own permissions; an admin with CanManageAccess can remove members of other, no or orphaned organizations but cannot replace their role

feature grant allow->deny->allow = granted; same version -> deny wins; wildcard allow -> WILDCARD_GRANT_FORBIDDEN for every actor; wildcard deny only by master-admin; a deny targeting a master-admin -> GRANT_TARGET_IS_MASTER_ADMIN; a non-master cannot self-grant (feature and resource), grant a feature it lacks, widen the target beyond its own organizations or features, or reverse a master-issued deny even after denying first; every new grant row records GrantedBy/GrantedByMasterAdmin; PermissionGrantsController returns 400/403 {code}
Wildcard_feature_claim_grants_no_management_access: POST /devices with an in-scope owner organization -> 403 for the missing devices.manage
IDeviceAccessResolver and the 5 handlers resolve from DI (scoped)
dotnet test Hms.Server.slnx green; frontend typecheck, test and build green
publicContracts: POST /api/v1/permissions/features and /resource-scopes: new 400 {code} for WILDCARD_GRANT_FORBIDDEN and GRANT_TARGET_IS_MASTER_ADMIN, new 403 {code} for SELF_GRANT_FORBIDDEN, GRANT_EXCEEDS_OWN_PERMISSIONS and GRANT_OVERRIDES_MASTER_DECISION; success bodies keep the grant-record shape and now carry the real grantor

POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/commands: request gains optional confirm (not part of the fingerprint, not persisted); still 200 with a body code, now PERMISSION_UNMAPPED, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, DEVICE_PERMISSION_REQUIRED, DEVICE_NOT_FOUND or DEVICE_REVOKED from DeviceAccessPolicy; the 404/403 status mapping belongs to phase 4
authorization semantics: latest grant wins instead of allow/deny union; a wildcard allow grants nothing; master-admin is decided before any deny and always sees every organization

Application interfaces: IUserScopeStore.IsMasterAdmin and IAuthorizationEpochStore.AdvanceMany added; SendDeviceCommandHandler constructor and HandleAsync take IDeviceAccessResolver and AccessActor; grant handlers take AccessActor and return PermissionGrantOutcome; DeviceCommandRequest gains trailing optional Confirm
removed public types: AuthorizationContext, AuthorizationDecision, DeviceAuthorizationPolicy

new public types: AccessActor, DeviceAccess, DeviceAccessDecision, DeviceAccessCodes, DeviceAccessPolicy, PermissionGrantResolver, ResolvedFeaturePermissions, ResolvedOrganizationSeeds, IDeviceAccessResolver, DeviceAccessResolver, DeviceAccessOutcome, DeviceAccessOutcomeCodes, the 5 delegation handlers, PermissionGrantOutcome, AccessActorFactory
no DB schema change; no frontend change
blastRadius: every HTTP route that uses ScopeAuthorization or the hms.user.manage / hms.permissions.manage policies (management controllers)
device command path (handler, controller, audit, idempotency order)
permission grant endpoints and their integration tests

MeController still reads raw grant rows until phase 4 switches it to PermissionGrantResolver.Features, so /me hints can differ from enforcement for wildcard allows and master-admin denies in between (UI hints only)
realtime keeps the PolicyVersion fence until phase 5; do not release before phases 4-5
scoutSummary: .NET 10 clean architecture (Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api), xUnit unit and integration tests (WebApplicationFactory). InMemory stores use _gate + lock; EF stores report InvalidOperationException(code). Phase 2 stores give compare-and-set on role Version and membership expectedRoleId. Design contract plans/261005-0556-device-permissions-what-where/reports/design-contract.md (§3, §4, §5, §6, §11) is binding. No PostgreSQL and no git repository in this environment.
